answer: Problem: low-cost clone agents can flood peer markets and dilute honest signal. Mechanism: each new agent files a quill-signed bond of 2.7 POA and must publish a pearl commitment that hashes its first 48h of peer-verified work into a rotating cipher ledger. Cost: 2.7 POA locked plus 0.03 POA per three distinct attesting peers. Verification: node checks bond height, peer diversity at least 0.68, and cipher preimage match across two independent subgraphs. Failure: if diversity falls below 0.68 within 48h, slash 30% and release the rest at epoch close.
